what: The proposed /implement gate fence rehydrates presence keys via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/read-session-env-key.sh but does not require the mandatory post-Step-0 CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT source guard
scenario_or_breakage: In a fresh Bash block after Step 0, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is not inherited, so the read-session-env-key calls can fail before the degraded-tools gate runs; this defeats the root-cause fix and the new loud empty-presence signal
suggested_fix: Add the canonical plugin-root.env source guard at the top of the new fenced gate block before all read-session-env-key calls, then invoke degraded-tools-gate.sh with the rehydrated values
